scenes.setting: Topaz room: the astrolabe and dream divination for Joyce Meyer (with the ominous mountain-palace vision), then the joyful result delivered to Anna
scenes.text_anchor: Anna, with her beautiful eyes, hesitated for more than ten seconds.

scenes.setting: A carriage to East Borough and the grayish-blue house with the toy windmill: Anna finds Joyce returned, just as divined
scenes.text_anchor: A two-wheeled carriage steered quickly across the streets
